name: Bibcite Import ORCID
description: Imports bibliography/citation data from ORCID into Bibcite.
project_description:
Bibcite Import Orcid 
 This Contrib module aims to import publications from ORCID public API into the 'Bibliography & Citation' module.

 The module can also fetch the biography from ORCID.

 Instructions 
 Install with composer

Enable the module

Configure in /admin/bibcite_import_orcid/config:

'Sync authors from ORCID' - A form will appear so you can choose which authors correspond to each user. This is the default option. If you disable it, the publications will be referenced directly in each user profile and no form will appear. This second option allows you to enable the 'Sync publications daily' option.

 Each user will have an 'Import from ORCID' button.

If 'Sync bios from ORCID' is enabled, you can set the biography sync preference for each user by editing the profile.

 Dependencies 
 
 Bibliography & Citation 
 Form Options Attributes
